title: Position
description: Information about a specific hiring appointment for a DOGE staffer

id.description: A unique ID for the employment term record

name.description: The name of the person being hired

alias.description: If this is an aliased position, the alias references

agency.description: The agency where the term of employment is

type.description: The type of position this is

from.description: For details, where he is detailed from

from_truth.description: How confident are we in this being the source agency for detailing/transfers

start_date.description: When the term of employment started (might be approximate)

end_date.description: When the term of employment ended (if a person has left the specific role through departure, promotion or reassignment)

end_type.description: The type of departure for this position

nte_date.description: If the NTE date for the appointment is known, it will be recorded here

signed_date.description: For detailing agreements, when it was signed

sort_date.description: Special string used for sorting if the start_date isn't set

fuzz.description: For comments on the fuzziness of some data

appt_type_code.description: A numeric code for the type of appointment

appt_type.description: A string description of the appointment type

sge.description: Appointed as a Special Government Employee meaning bypassing ethics disclosures

pay_grade.description: A string description of the pay scale and grade (eg, GS-15)

salary.description: A string description of the salary

pd_code.description: The position description identifier for this specific position

supervisory.description: Boolean to indicate if the position is supervisory

excepted.description: Boolean to indicate if the position is excepted/non-competitive

office.description: The office where the position will report to

reimbursement_amount.description: If it is reimbursed, the amount of the reimbursement

comment.description: For free-form comments on the record

qualifications.description: Qualifications listed for the special hiring

table_note.description: A short note to display in the position

replaced_by.description: If the role was succeeded by another, give by here

same_as.description: For use in aliases, indicates that the position is the same as another one publicly known (the two can be merged)

mou.description: A link to a MOU if the position has one
